def transform(grid):
    """Intersect the foreground pixels in the two panels and recolor them 2."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    left_width = divider
    right_width = w - divider - 1
    assert left_width == right_width
    return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][divider + 1 + c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(left_width)] for r in range(h)]
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    anchors = {r: row[0] for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0}
    # The band pattern repeats with its shortest compatible period.
    period = next(p for p in range(1, h + 1)
                  if all(anchors[a] == anchors[b]
                         for a in anchors for b in anchors
                         if a < b and (a - b) % p == 0))
    phases = {r % period: color for r, color in anchors.items()}
    known = sorted(phases)
    for i in range(period):
        if i not in phases:
            # Extend the periodic phase pattern using nearest preceding phase.
            preceding = [k for k in known if k < i]
            phases[i] = phases[preceding[-1]] if preceding else phases[known[-1]]
    return [[phases[r % period]] * w for r in range(h)]
